title: 第4章 挣钱是第一要务！-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “那我帮您混出去！”

    沈珩挑眉。

    韩小汐已经跳下床，从帆布包里翻出一条大红色围巾，地摊货，十五块一条，但够大够艳。

    又摸出一副黑框平光眼镜，画画时防近视用的，丑得别致。

    韩小汐有些小开心，原主的品味莫名很投她胃口。

    “低头。”她踮起脚。

    沈珩微微俯身。

    她把围巾在他脖子上绕了两圈，一端松松地搭在肩头，遮住小半张脸。

    又把眼镜架在他鼻梁上，退后一步，歪头端详。

    “行了。”韩小汐满意地点头，“您现在看起来像一个感冒发烧的普通大学生。”

    说着她又拎起袋子去了卫生间，“您等我一下，我去换衣服。”

    沈珩“嗯”了声，摘下眼镜，看着丑得出奇的款式，沉默数秒，又默默戴了回去。

    韩小汐很快出来，很普通的黑色短款羽绒服，牛仔裤，奶咖色毛线帽。

    “情侣装呢！”韩小汐觉得自己入戏了，桃花眼弯弯，“走吧，男朋友。”

    沈珩的动作明显顿了一下。

    “演戏演全套，沈老师配合一下。”韩小汐笑得狡黠，“您是我男朋友，生病了，我来接您回家。您跟着我就行。”

    她伸手挽住他的胳膊，自然地往门外带。

    面上淡然，心脏却扑通扑通地乱跳。

    沈珩低头，看了一眼挽在自己臂弯里的小手，小拇指微微翘着，指甲其实也不算太长。

    他收回视线，配合地咳嗽了两声。

    演戏他是专业的。

    走廊里，韩小汐靠在他肩头，絮絮叨叨：“你说你，大冬天穿这么少，不发烧才怪。回去给我好好休息，听到没？”

    沈珩又咳了一声，含混地“嗯”了一声。

    经过电梯口时，蹲守的记者只是扫了他们一眼。

    毕竟一个啰嗦粘人的女生，一个裹得只露眼睛的男生，大红色围巾土得扎眼，一看就是附近的大学生，没什么看头。

    电梯门打开的瞬间，韩小汐挽着他走进去。

    沈珩不紧不慢地按下了负一楼。

    门关上。

    韩小汐长叹了口气，准备松开手。

    却被男人按住了。

    “演戏演到底，电梯里随时会有人上下。”他俯身贴着她耳侧低语。

    韩小汐秒懂。

    耳根一阵发热。

    说话就说话，靠这么近做什么！
    第(1/3)页

"Then I'll help you get out!"

Shen Heng raised his eyebrows.

Han Xiaoxi had already jumped out of bed and took out a big red scarf from the canvas bag. It was sold at a street stall and cost fifteen yuan a piece, but it was big and colorful.

He also took out a pair of black-framed plain glasses, used to prevent myopia when painting, they were so ugly.

Han Xiaoxi was a little happy because the original owner's taste was inexplicably to her liking.

"Lower your head." She stood on tiptoe.

Shen Heng leaned forward slightly.

She wrapped the scarf twice around his neck and put one end loosely on her shoulder, covering less than half of his face.

He put his glasses on the bridge of his nose, took a step back, and tilted his head to take a closer look.

"Okay." Han Xiaoxi nodded with satisfaction, "You look like an ordinary college student with a cold and fever now."

As she said that, she picked up the bag and went to the bathroom, "Wait for me, I'll go change clothes."

Shen Heng said "hmm", took off his glasses, looked at the surprisingly ugly style, was silent for a few seconds, and then put them back on silently.

Han Xiaoxi came out quickly, wearing a very ordinary black short down jacket, jeans, and a milky coffee-colored woolen hat.

"They're dressed up as a couple!" Han Xiaoxi felt like she was in a drama, her peach blossom eyes curled up, "Let's go, boyfriend."

Shen Heng’s movements obviously paused.

"Perform a full play, Teacher Shen will cooperate with you." Han Xiaoxi smiled slyly, "You are my boyfriend, you are sick, I will take you home. Just follow me."

She reached out to hold his arm and led him out the door naturally.

His face was calm, but his heart was beating wildly.

Shen Heng lowered his head and glanced at the little hand held in his arm. The little finger was slightly raised, and the nails were actually not too long.

He looked away and coughed twice in coordination.

He is professional in acting.

In the corridor, Han Xiaoxi leaned on his shoulder and murmured: "You said you, you wear so little in the winter, it would be strange if you don't have a fever. Go back and give me a good rest, do you hear me?"

Shen Heng coughed again and said vaguely "Hmm".

When they passed the elevator entrance, the reporters on guard just glanced at them.

“After all, a girl who is verbose and clingy, and a boy whose eyes are covered with a bright red scarf that is too dazzling, look like a nearby college student, so they are not much to look at.

The moment the elevator door opened, Han Xiaoxi held his arm and walked in.

Shen Heng pressed the button on the first floor downstairs unhurriedly.

The door is closed.

Han Xiaoxi let out a long sigh and prepared to let go.

But he was held down by a man.

"Perform your acting to the end. There will be people getting up and down in the elevator at any time." He leaned over and whispered in her ear.

Han Xiaoxi understood instantly.

The roots of my ears felt warm.

Just talk, why are you so close?
